title_candidates: Samsung's ChatGPT and Codex rollout shows AI is becoming company infrastructure
summary: OpenAI says Samsung Electronics is rolling out ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex broadly. The signal is less about Samsung and more about how workplace AI is being governed.

primary_source.title: Samsung Electronics brings ChatGPT and Codex to employees
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI says Samsung Electronics is making ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex available to all Samsung Electronics employees in Korea and all worldwide Device eXperience employees.
OpenAI describes the Samsung rollout as one of its largest enterprise deployments to date.
Samsung plans to use ChatGPT and Codex across software development, marketing, product development, manufacturing, corporate functions, and other areas.
OpenAI says more than 5 million people now use Codex each week for technical and non-technical workflows.

prerequisites: A workplace AI pilot, team tool rollout, or interest in evaluating one

steps.instruction: Write down one workflow where your team already uses AI informally, such as drafting, analysis, code review, or reporting.
Check whether the tool is personal, team-managed, or enterprise-managed.
Ask who controls data retention, user access, app approvals, and audit logs.
Define one allowed use, one banned use, and one review checkpoint before expanding access.
Only scale the rollout after a real task shows measurable time saved or quality improved.
